findings.title: Declared power units (12) vs active fleet schedule units (2)

materiality.rationale: Vehicle count is a pricing-sensitive rating input

findings.possible_consequence: Quote may be rated on a different unit count than the eligible fleet
findings.recommended_action: Reconcile declared power units against the fleet schedule; confirm inclusion criteria and reporting dates before adjusting rating inputs

findings.title: WC payroll differs between acord_130 and wc_rating_workbook

materiality.rationale: Payroll is the WC exposure base

findings.uncertainty_reason: Periods/inclusion criteria assumed comparable; confirm before treating as final
findings.possible_consequence: Quote may use payroll inconsistent with the application
findings.recommended_action: Reconcile payroll by class and location across the application, workbook, and quote; verify periods align

findings.title: Evidence-backed cargo_value (250,000) exceeds quoted cargo limit (100,000)

materiality.rationale: Potential under-insurance of an evidence-backed peak exposure

findings.uncertainty_reason: Data inconsistency confirmed; coverage outcome requires specialist interpretation of policy wording
findings.possible_consequence: Peak exposure exceeds the quoted limit by 150,000 (150.0%).
findings.recommended_action: Refer to a coverage specialist; confirm peak values with the insured and consider limit adequacy. No legal coverage conclusion is made.

findings.title: Experience modification factor differs across documents

materiality.rationale: Experience mod directly multiplies WC premium

findings.uncertainty_reason: Approved current experience-mod source unavailable; which value is correct cannot be determined from the submission alone
findings.possible_consequence: Quote may apply an incorrect experience modification: A-ACORD130: 0.9 (eff 2026-01-01); A-QUOTE: 1.02 (eff 2026-01-01); A-WCWB: 1.02 (eff 2026-01-01)
findings.recommended_action: Obtain the current bureau experience-mod worksheet for the proposed effective date and validate the factor; do not select a factor based on recency alone

findings.title: No current driver roster / MVR review evidence in submission

materiality.rationale: Driver qualification cannot be reviewed without a current roster

findings.uncertainty_reason: Missing evidence is not proof that any driver is unqualified
findings.possible_consequence: Driver eligibility, MVR review status, and heavy-vehicle qualification cannot be verified; 'driver_roster' marked missing; 'quote_statement:driver_roster_attached' marked False; fleet schedule references assigned drivers
findings.recommended_action: Request the current driver roster and MVR review evidence; do not infer driver disqualification from absence

findings.title: 1 heavy vehicle(s) (GVWR >= 26001) but no driver roster/credentials supplied

materiality.rationale: Qualification of heavy-vehicle drivers cannot be reviewed

findings.uncertainty_reason: Absent roster/credentials is an evidence gap, not a confirmed qualification mismatch
findings.possible_consequence: Heavy-vehicle driver qualification cannot be verified
findings.recommended_action: Request driver roster with license class/CDL endorsements for assigned drivers of heavy units

findings.title: Unit U-2: garaging state code OR conflicts with garaging address state CA
findings.possible_consequence: Territory/rating may be wrong for this unit; neither field is overwritten automatically
findings.recommended_action: Confirm the actual garaging address and state for the unit

findings.title: ACORD 130 schedule omits workbook state(s): AZ

materiality.rationale: Incomplete state schedule can omit exposure from review
